$comment: The loader's refusals in one place: loader.h's enum runtime_refusal in order (scripts/loader-refusals.test.mjs holds the two together), a short label for logs, what a developer does next, and what the site tells a musician. A code without its own musician text shows the site's plain 'can't run this module file'. `subjects`: what a refusal met, loader.h's enum runtime_met in order, which the base reports beside the code (vendor request 41); {what} and {module} are filled from the record, and a subject's musician text replaces its refusal's.

subjects.name: RUNTIME_MET_EVENT
subjects.developer: it met the base's event at hook index {what}

subjects.name: RUNTIME_MET_FEATURE
subjects.developer: it needs base feature bits {what} that this base lacks
subjects.musician: This module needs a part of the Modwerk base that the base on your Octatrack doesn’t have. Update the base, then sync again.

subjects.name: RUNTIME_MET_SITE
subjects.developer: its site at {what} patches the same stock code as {module}
subjects.musician: This module changes the same part of the Octatrack as {module}. Remove one of the two, then sync again.

subjects.name: RUNTIME_MET_CLAIM
subjects.developer: it claims the DSP word {what} that {module} already holds
subjects.musician: This module uses the same DSP memory as {module}. Remove one of the two, then sync again.

refusals.name: RUNTIME_OK
refusals.label: no refusal
refusals.developer: The loader refused nothing: the step failed before or after it.

refusals.name: RUNTIME_MALFORMED
refusals.label: malformed
refusals.developer: The package is not one this base reads (ABI, header, counts or bounds). Rebuild it for the running base.

refusals.name: RUNTIME_MEMORY
refusals.label: module memory
refusals.developer: The module pool or a DSP memory window has no room for it. Remove a module or make this one smaller.
refusals.musician: There isn’t enough module memory left on the Octatrack. Remove a module, then try again.

refusals.name: RUNTIME_CONFLICT
refusals.label: conflict
refusals.developer: It meets a live module: a site, a claim, a hook entry or a feature the base lacks. Run `npm run modules:compat` on the set. Also what a packaged engine (Analog BD) gets once a DSP core's loader transport closed for the boot: a restart clears that.
refusals.musician: A module in this sync changes the same part of the Octatrack as one that’s already installed. If these modules have worked together before, restart the Octatrack and sync again.

refusals.name: RUNTIME_FULL
refusals.label: no free handle
refusals.developer: Every module handle or a hook's room is taken. Remove a module.
refusals.musician: The Octatrack has no room for another module. Remove one, then try again.

refusals.name: RUNTIME_BUSY
refusals.label: busy
refusals.developer: DSP code is moving or a resident controller is settling. Try again within a few seconds.
refusals.musician: The Octatrack is still loading module code. Try again in a moment.

refusals.name: RUNTIME_CYCLES
refusals.label: DSP time
refusals.developer: Its declared DSP cycles pass the slot's budget. Lower the cost or the declaration.
refusals.musician: This module needs more DSP time than an effect slot has.

refusals.name: RUNTIME_IN_USE
refusals.label: in use
refusals.developer: A track runs the effect or machine it would replace or remove, or one of the bank's Parts names it. Pick another effect or machine there first.
refusals.musician: A track is using a module this sync changes or removes, as its effect or its machine, so the Octatrack can’t change it now. Pick another effect or machine on that track (check the bank’s other Parts too), then try again.

refusals.name: RUNTIME_STOCK
refusals.label: stock bytes differ
refusals.developer: The bytes under one of its sites are not the stock bytes its hash names: another OS version, or something already patched there.
refusals.musician: This module doesn’t match what is running on your Octatrack, so nothing changed. Report it in #beta-testers on Discord.

refusals.name: RUNTIME_EVENT
refusals.label: a base event
refusals.developer: A site or copy meets a stock site the base owns as an event. Subscribe to that event instead.
refusals.musician: This version of the module changes a part of the Octatrack that the base now shares between modules. Install its newer version.

refusals.name: RUNTIME_FEATURE
refusals.label: a base feature down
refusals.developer: A base feature it requires cannot come up this boot (the key bus after a DSP core lost its state). Restart the unit, then retry.
refusals.musician: The Octatrack can’t start the key bus this module needs until it restarts. Turn it off and on, then sync again.
